blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content: The *Khovanov-Lauda-Rouquier algebras* (*KLR algebras*) were introduced independently by Khovanov-Lauda [@KL09; @KL11] and Rouquier [@R08] to give a categorification of quantum groups. Let $U_q(\mathfrak{g})$ be the quantum group associated with a symmetrizable Cartan datum, and let $R$ be the corresponding KLR algebra. For a dominant integral weight $\lambda$ of $U_q(\mathfrak{g})$, the algebra $R$ has a special quotient $R^{\lambda}$ corresponding to $\lambda$, which is called the *cyclotomic Khovanov-Lauda-Rouquier algebra* ( *cyclotomic KLR algebra*) of weight $\lambda$. blocks.title: Construction of irreducible R-modules
blocks.content: In this subsection, we give a construction of irreducible graded $R$-modules as the irreducible heads of certain induced modules, which is compatible with the Kashiwara operators. Let $\mathfrak{B}_k$ be the crystal obtained from $B(\infty)$ by forgetting the $i$-arrows for $i \notin  I_{(k)}$.
